pilot_home_copy.en: Pitrè counted roughly fifty people drawn from Palermo's fishing trades as bearers of a particular saints' processional litter.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Pitrè dénombrait environ cinquante personnes issues des métiers de la pêche à Palerme comme porteurs d'un brancard de procession des saints.

source.primary_locator: Giuseppe Pitrè, Feste patronali in Sicilia, printed p. 79

records.region_scope: Historical Sicilian locality named in Pitrè (1900); not current universal practice

pilot_home_copy.en: In an old June Eucharistic festival at Geraci Siculo, Pitrè reports that local shepherds processed on horseback rather than walking.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Lors d'une ancienne fête eucharistique de juin à Geraci Siculo, Pitrè rapporte que les bergers locaux défilaient à cheval plutôt qu'à pied.

source.primary_locator: Giuseppe Pitrè, Feste patronali in Sicilia, printed p. 126

records.region_scope: Historical Sicilian locality named in Pitrè (1900); not current universal practice

pilot_home_copy.en: Older shepherds in a historical Geraci Siculo cavalcade carried bunches of wax tied with ribbons.
pilot_home_copy.fr: De vieux bergers portaient des bouquets de cire noués de rubans lors d'une ancienne cavalcade à Geraci Siculo.

source.primary_locator: Giuseppe Pitrè, Feste patronali in Sicilia, printed p. 128

records.region_scope: Historical Sicilian locality named in Pitrè (1900); not current universal practice

pilot_home_copy.en: The 1956 Rural Life Prayerbook's blessing of cheese or butter specifically thanks God for food made from animal milk, and asks grace for those sharing it.
pilot_home_copy.fr: La bénédiction du fromage ou du beurre dans le Rural Life Prayerbook de 1956 remercie Dieu pour cet aliment tiré du lait animal et demande des grâces pour ceux qui le partagent.

source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: A traditional blessing for ripe grapes thanks God for dew, rain and mild weather; it appears in the 1956 Rural Life Prayerbook.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Une bénédiction traditionnelle des raisins mûrs remercie Dieu pour la rosée, la pluie et le temps clément ; elle figure dans le Rural Life Prayerbook de 1956.

source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: The blessing for wine intended for the sick in the Rural Life Prayerbook invokes the wedding at Cana, rather than the Saint John's Day wine custom.
pilot_home_copy.fr: La bénédiction du vin destiné aux malades dans le Rural Life Prayerbook invoque les noces de Cana, et non la coutume du vin de la Saint-Jean.

source.primary_locator: Blessing of Wine for the Sick
source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: A Catholic blessing of medicine printed in 1956 explicitly acknowledges remedies used against illness and asks for the patient's health of body and mind.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Une bénédiction catholique des médicaments publiée en 1956 reconnaît les remèdes employés contre la maladie et demande la santé du corps et de l'esprit du malade.

source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: The old blessing of horses or other animals invokes Saint Anthony the Hermit, seeking protection for the animals; it is printed in a 1956 rural prayerbook.
pilot_home_copy.fr: L'ancienne bénédiction des chevaux et autres animaux invoque saint Antoine l'Ermite pour leur protection ; elle figure dans un recueil rural de 1956.

source.primary_locator: A Blessing for Horses or Other Animals
source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: A prayer over poultry in the 1956 Rural Life Prayerbook recalls both the birds of Genesis and Noah's offering after the Flood.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Une prière sur les volailles dans le Rural Life Prayerbook de 1956 rappelle à la fois les oiseaux de la Genèse et l'offrande de Noé après le Déluge.

source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: The 1956 Rural Life Prayerbook includes a specific blessing of salt or feed placed before farm animals, distinct from prayers over buildings or harvests.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le Rural Life Prayerbook de 1956 comporte une bénédiction particulière du sel ou du fourrage destinés aux animaux de la ferme, distincte des prières sur les bâtiments ou les récoltes.

source.primary_locator: Blessing of Salt or Feed for Animals
source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: The old prayer for sprouting seed asks for soft winds and heavenly dew to help young crops mature, as printed in the 1956 Rural Life Prayerbook.
pilot_home_copy.fr: L'ancienne prière pour les semences en germination demande des vents doux et la rosée du ciel pour mener les jeunes cultures à maturité, selon le recueil de 1956.

source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: A traditional blessing of fruit trees and vines also asks that a fertile harvest feed those who are hungry and give the poor cause to thank God.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Une bénédiction traditionnelle des arbres fruitiers et des vignes demande aussi que la récolte nourrisse les affamés et donne aux pauvres motif de remercier Dieu.

source.primary_locator: Blessing of All Kinds of Fruit Trees and Vines
source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: A 1956 Catholic blessing of a grain mill asks God to send an angel to protect the building where grain is ground into bread flour.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Une bénédiction catholique de 1956 pour un moulin à céréales demande à Dieu d'envoyer un ange protéger le bâtiment où le grain devient farine.

source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: An older Catholic blessing asks that a spring or well serve the ordinary needs of people who draw or drink its water.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Une ancienne bénédiction catholique demande qu'une source ou un puits serve les besoins quotidiens de ceux qui y puisent ou boivent de l'eau.

source.primary_locator: Blessing of a Spring or Well
source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: The 1956 Rural Life Prayerbook reproduces a blessing of a bridge that asks protection for all who cross it, in success or adversity.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le Rural Life Prayerbook de 1956 reproduit une bénédiction d'un pont demandant la protection de tous ceux qui le traversent, dans la réussite comme dans l'épreuve.

source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: The 1956 Rural Life Prayerbook prints a blessing of newly kindled fire asking that, beyond worldly darkness, the faithful reach God's unfailing light.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le Rural Life Prayerbook de 1956 imprime une bénédiction d'un feu nouvellement allumé, demandant qu'au-delà des ténèbres du monde les fidèles parviennent à la lumière divine sans déclin.

source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

records.region_scope: Historical 1956 Catholic rural blessing, not a current universal Mass obligation

pilot_home_copy.en: The 1956 Rural Life Prayerbook gives a blessing not only for cars and wagons, but also for tractors used in farm work.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le Rural Life Prayerbook de 1956 propose une bénédiction non seulement pour les voitures et les chariots, mais aussi pour les tracteurs agricoles.

source.primary_locator: Blessing of an Automobile, a Wagon, or Tractor
source.original_edition: Alban J. Dachauer, The Rural Life Prayerbook (1956)

pilot_home_copy.en: At a Requiem Mass, the celebrant does not kiss the Gospel book or say Per evangelica dicta after reading the Gospel.
pilot_home_copy.fr: À la messe de Requiem, le célébrant ne baise pas le livre de l'Évangile et ne dit pas Per evangelica dicta après sa lecture.

source.original_edition: Ritus servandus (1962) English translation; page image individually read

pilot_home_copy.en: At Solemn Mass the subdeacon carries the Epistle book against his breast and sings the Epistle facing the altar while the celebrant listens seated.
pilot_home_copy.fr: À la messe solennelle, le sous-diacre porte l'épistolier contre sa poitrine et chante l'Épître face à l'autel pendant que le célébrant l'écoute assis.

source.original_edition: Ritus servandus (1962) English translation; page image individually read

records.region_scope: Traditional Roman Mass 1962; conditionally applicable celebrant or sacred minister rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: After singing the Epistle at Solemn Mass, the subdeacon normally receives the celebrant's blessing; this blessing is omitted at Requiem Masses.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Après avoir chanté l'Épître à la messe solennelle, le sous-diacre reçoit normalement la bénédiction du célébrant ; celle-ci est omise aux messes de Requiem.

source.original_edition: Ritus servandus (1962) English translation; page image individually read

records.region_scope: Traditional Roman Mass 1962; conditionally applicable celebrant or sacred minister rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: When a sermon is preached at the traditional Roman Mass, the 1962 Ritus places it after the Gospel and before the Credo, or the Offertory when no Credo is said.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Lorsqu'une prédication a lieu à la messe romaine traditionnelle, le Ritus de 1962 la place après l'Évangile et avant le Credo, ou l'offertoire si le Credo est omis.

source.original_edition: Ritus servandus (1962) English translation; page image individually read

records.region_scope: Traditional Roman Mass 1962; conditionally applicable celebrant or sacred minister rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: At Solemn Mass during the sung Et incarnatus est of the Credo, the deacon brings the burse from the credence table and unfolds the corporal on the altar.
pilot_home_copy.fr: À la messe solennelle pendant Et incarnatus est chanté au Credo, le diacre apporte la bourse depuis la crédence et déploie le corporal sur l'autel.

source.original_edition: Ritus servandus (1962) English translation; page image individually read

records.region_scope: Traditional Roman Mass 1962; conditionally applicable celebrant or sacred minister rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: The 1962 Ritus allows the Epistle of a sung Mass to be sung by a minister; otherwise the celebrant may read or sing it.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le Ritus de 1962 permet qu'à la messe chantée l'Épître soit chantée par un ministre ; sinon, le célébrant peut la lire ou la chanter.

source.original_edition: Ritus servandus (1962) English translation; page image individually read

records.region_scope: Traditional Roman Mass 1962; conditionally applicable celebrant or sacred minister rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: At the Offertory, the celebrant's intention of offering and consecrating includes additional Hosts placed in another vessel for the faithful's Communion.
pilot_home_copy.fr: À l'offertoire, l'intention du célébrant d'offrir et de consacrer englobe aussi les hosties placées dans un autre récipient pour la communion des fidèles.

source.original_edition: Ritus servandus (1962) English translation; page image individually read

records.region_scope: Traditional Roman Mass 1962; conditionally applicable celebrant or sacred minister rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: The 1962 Ritus describes the Lavabo as washing the ends of the priest's fingers, particularly thumb and forefinger, rather than washing both hands entirely.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le Ritus de 1962 décrit le Lavabo comme un lavage des extrémités des doigts du prêtre, notamment du pouce et de l'index, et non comme un lavage complet des deux mains.

source.original_edition: Ritus servandus (1962) English translation; page image individually read
